name: M3_PMS100MI_Get
description: Retrieve detailed header information for a single manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: FACI
inputParameters.description: Facility where the manufacturing order is registered.

inputParameters.name: PRNO
inputParameters.description: Product number of the item manufactured on the order.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number of the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: REAR
inputParameters.description: Planning area used as an additional key when retrieving the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number of the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: FACI
outputParameters.description: Facility where the manufacturing order is registered.

outputParameters.name: MFNO
outputParameters.description: Manufacturing order number.

outputParameters.name: PRNO
outputParameters.description: Product number of the item manufactured on the order.

outputParameters.name: ITDS
outputParameters.description: Description of the manufactured product.

outputParameters.name: RORC
outputParameters.description: Category indicating the type of reference order linked to the manufacturing order, such as customer or purchase order.

outputParameters.name: RORN
outputParameters.description: Reference order number, such as a customer or purchase order, linked to the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: RORL
outputParameters.description: Line number on the reference order associated with the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: RORX
outputParameters.description: Line suffix used to distinguish sub-lines on the reference order line linked to the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: MFCD
outputParameters.description: Higher-level manufacturing order number within the order structure, if applicable.

outputParameters.name: WHST
outputParameters.description: Current status of the manufacturing order in the production process.

outputParameters.name: ORQT
outputParameters.description: Ordered quantity for the manufacturing order in the basic unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: MAQT
outputParameters.description: Accumulated manufactured quantity for the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: PRIO
outputParameters.description: Priority of the manufacturing order for planning and scheduling.

outputParameters.name: STDT
outputParameters.description: Planned start date of the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: MSTI
outputParameters.description: Planned start time of the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: FIDT
outputParameters.description: Planned finish date of the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: MFTI
outputParameters.description: Planned finish time of the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: NNDT
outputParameters.description: Alternate planning date proposed by the system when rescheduling the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: PULD
outputParameters.description: Pull-up control used for delayed manufacturing orders in advanced planning and scheduling.

outputParameters.name: PULN
outputParameters.description: Pull-up control used for non-delayed manufacturing orders in advanced planning and scheduling.

outputParameters.name: RIFD
outputParameters.description: Filter date from which reschedule-in proposals are evaluated for the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: ROFD
outputParameters.description: Filter date from which reschedule-out proposals are evaluated for the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: CLGP
outputParameters.description: Color group used to visually categorize the manufacturing order in the scheduling workbench.

outputParameters.name: TSDA
outputParameters.description: System timestamp date for the manufacturing order record.

outputParameters.name: TSTE
outputParameters.description: System timestamp time for the manufacturing order record.

outputParameters.name: TXT1
outputParameters.description: Free text line 1 for additional information about the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: TXT2
outputParameters.description: Free text line 2 for additional information about the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: LMDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the manufacturing order header was last changed.

outputParameters.name: CHNO
outputParameters.description: Change number associated with the latest update of the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: CHID
outputParameters.description: User ID who last changed the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: SUBN
outputParameters.description: Sub-network identifier used to group the manufacturing order within a planning network.

outputParameters.name: PRAP
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the manufacturing order has been processed by the advanced planning and scheduling tool.

outputParameters.name: HDPR
outputParameters.description: Main product number associated with the manufacturing order, if any.

outputParameters.name: DUED
outputParameters.description: Due date when the manufacturing order is planned to be completed or delivered.

outputParameters.name: RGDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the manufacturing order was created.

outputParameters.name: RGTM
outputParameters.description: Time when the manufacturing order was created.

outputParameters.name: ACTP
outputParameters.description: Planning action message indicating suggested actions for the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: NTWP
outputParameters.description: External network priority used when integrating the manufacturing order with external planning tools.

outputParameters.name: ACHD
outputParameters.description: Date when the manufacturing order was last changed by the advanced planning and scheduling tool.

outputParameters.name: ACHT
outputParameters.description: Time when the manufacturing order was last changed by the advanced planning and scheduling tool.

outputParameters.name: WHLO
outputParameters.description: Warehouse where the manufactured product on the order will be produced or stored.

outputParameters.name: CFXX
outputParameters.description: Previous configuration number used for the manufacturing order, if any.

outputParameters.name: MAUN
outputParameters.description: Unit of measure in which the manufacturing order quantity is expressed.

outputParameters.name: CFIN
outputParameters.description: Configuration number uniquely identifying the product configuration for the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: RSDT
outputParameters.description: Actual start date when the manufacturing order was first reported.

outputParameters.name: REFD
outputParameters.description: Actual finish date when the manufacturing order receipt was reported.

outputParameters.name: SCHN
outputParameters.description: Schedule number grouping the manufacturing order in production planning.

outputParameters.name: ORQA
outputParameters.description: Ordered quantity for the manufacturing order expressed in the alternate unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: BANO
outputParameters.description: Lot number to assign to the manufactured item on the order, if predefined.

outputParameters.name: MAQA
outputParameters.description: Accumulated manufactured quantity for the manufacturing order expressed in the manufacturing unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: RVQT
outputParameters.description: Quantity received for the manufacturing order in the basic unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: RVQA
outputParameters.description: Quantity received for the manufacturing order expressed in the alternate unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: MREC
outputParameters.description: Manual reclassification date when the manufactured lot may be moved from quality status 1 to 2.

outputParameters.name: MRCT
outputParameters.description: Time of day on the manual reclassification date when the manufactured lot may be reclassified.

outputParameters.name: AGBF
outputParameters.description: Setting indicating whether backflush issue transactions for the manufacturing order are aggregated or handled in detail.

outputParameters.name: MOLK
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the manufacturing order is locked for changes, for example by an external system.

outputParameters.name: RPDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the latest reporting transaction for this manufacturing order was performed.

outputParameters.name: PCDO
outputParameters.description: Status indicating whether order costing and production statistics have been performed for the manufacturing order.
